title: os/stream SSE wire event
description: One data: payload on GET /kb/os/stream (os-kit OS-2). Events carry only the type and the time, never data: they tell the System view when to re-fetch GET /kb/os/state. The stream opens with one hello event. The SSE event: line equals type. Every variant sets additionalProperties:false, so a field added server-side must be added here in the same edit.

oneOf.title: hello
oneOf.description: The first event on connect: the stream is open.

oneOf.title: activity
oneOf.description: An activity row was recorded (kb/activity.mjs). Carries no payload; the client re-fetches GET /kb/os/state. Bursts of one type are coalesced to at most one event per 250 ms per stream.

at.description: ISO 8601 time the change was published to the stream.
